milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate/observe' task. The agent must navigate close enough to the redstone block (at spawn-relative 6, 1, 6 inside the cobblestone structure) and face toward it, confirming visual identification. max_distance=5 ensures the agent is close enough to clearly see the block (within or just outside the structure doorway), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the agent is actually looking at it rather than facing away.
